summary: Anthropic interpretability researchers present a technique for identifying verbalizable internal representations in language models, arguing these form a privileged 'global workspace' distinct from other model processing.

practices.reason: A new interpretability technique for surfacing verbalizable concepts could inform how engineers probe model internals, but it is described as a research finding rather than a transferable tool.
practices.quote: We identify these representations using a new interpretability technique, which surfaces the concepts a model is poised to verbalize at any point in its processing.
